title: Adventure Begins - 16x16 Retro Tiles & Characters
author: Zaebucca
summary: A 16×16 overworld, interior and character collection by Zaebucca. The page allows commercial projects and names PNG files, and it forbids resale of the assets.
engineNote: PNG content is named inside the listed ZIPs. No native engine package was verified, so import and setup are manual.
licenseNote: The page allows personal and commercial projects and adaptation of the art. It forbids claiming, redistributing or selling the assets, including modified files, and it excludes NFT, metaverse and AI uses.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $14.99 crossed out to $7.49. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: Three named content ZIPs cover overworld, characters and interiors, with 80 ratings at 4.9 and an explicit commercial license. Value is strong at half of $14.99; the archives were not audited file by file.

title: Godot 3D Pixelart Starter Kit (Update 1)
author: OrdinaryCicadaCreator
summary: A Godot 4.6 Forward+ prototype by OrdinaryCicadaCreator with cel, foliage, water and outline shaders plus a demo scene. Original content is listed as CC0; third-party files keep their own licenses.
engineNote: The page names a Godot 4.6 zip and a separate water shader file. The archive was not inspected, so this is not a verified native Godot project and setup remains manual.

publisherPreview.alt: Publisher screenshot of a 3D pixel-art Godot demo scene with cel-shaded lighting.
publisherPreview.note: Observed as an original PNG in this product's public itch.io gallery. Linked from img.itch.zone; no artwork or paid pack files were copied. This preview check does not refresh price or license verification.

licenseNote: The page releases original download content under CC0, including commercial use without credit, and says third-party content keeps its own license.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $8.99 crossed out to $3.59. This is a paid sale, not a free claim.

curation.rationale: The listing documents shaders, camera controls and a demo scene at 60% off $8.99. Six perfect ratings are a small sample, so reputation stays adequate rather than strong; paid files were not audited.

title: All Fonts Pack
author: Chequered Ink
summary: Over 1200 commercial OTF and TTF font styles by Chequered Ink in one 23 MB sorted ZIP. The page documents full commercial use for small businesses and names the archive on the product page.
engineNote: The page lists Chequered Ink All Fonts Pack Sorted.zip with OTF and TTF inside. No engine project was verified; install fonts manually.
licenseNote: The page states pay-once unlimited commercial use for qualifying small businesses and links separate license terms. The archive was not downloaded.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $190 crossed out to $19. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: 1200+ named font styles in one sorted ZIP with 155 ratings at 5.0 and explicit commercial terms. Value is exceptional at 90% off $190; individual font files were not audited.
